category_title: Autistic students who partially process problems with discrepancy gestures and echolalia
scenario_title: Identifying geometric shapes with multiple visual distractors
minimal_context: Rico is working on a task sheet to identify and mark images of concrete objects shaped like a beam and a ball.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at this task sheet. Find the images shaped like a beam and a ball, and put a checkmark next to them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Focuses on the objects with irregular hand movements. He moves his hand as if about to put a checkmark on the pencil and cap, but hesitates and turns his attention to the tissue box) Tissue... tissue...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep looking at the pictures. Which one is the beam?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (His view slowly turns, observing the variety of objects. He makes a discrepancy gesture, pointing his finger at the image of the cap while looking at the beam)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What about the ball? Can you find the ball?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (He ignores the image of the marbles. His hand movements give a checkmark on the picture of the hat instead. He stares at the canned milk and repeats quickly) Canned milk, canned milk.
